title: New Disney CEO’s first week on the job was upset by 3 big developments | Fortune
summary: The article discusses the collapse of major partnerships and developments affecting Disney's vision for a unified digital entertainment platform, including the dissolution of the deal with OpenAI and the setbacks in Epic Games' Fortnite updates.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to the impact of the dissolved partnerships and the failure of Fortnite updates to increase engagement, which affects Disney's strategic plans and investments.
